text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- National Democratic Rally (RND) gathers its 155 members, newly elected to the National Assembly, on Thursday.
- RND leader Abdelkader Bensalah says outcome of last week's general election reflected the real political forces in Algeria.

- The next head of the government will be known on Sunday. Islamist Movement of a Peaceful Society and National Liberation Front oppose incumbent Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia being renamed while the RND opposes alliance with Islamist-leaning parties.
- Opposition parties await Constitutional Council decisions on alleged vote irregularities.
- Security forces kill between four and 14 "terrorists" near Reghaia, east of Algiers. "Terrorist gang" kills six civilians in Chelf province.
- Politicians' bargaining focuse on the name of next prime minister and who will head the parliament.
